6/ Technology Integration 🤖

AI-powered surveillance cameras monitor crowd density to prevent stampedes.
Multilingual chatbot (11 languages!) with Google Maps integration for navigation & support.
#SmartIndia #TechForGood #AI #Kumbh2025

7/ Public Health Awareness 📢

Campaigns to spread safety guidelines via public address systems & signage.
Emergency contact info widely shared; authorized bathing areas strictly enforced.
#HealthAwareness #SafetyFirst #kumbhmela2025prayagraj

8/ A Mega Effort for a Mega Event
The Maha Kumbh Mela is not just a spiritual gathering but a logistical marvel. UP Govt is pulling all stops to ensure it’s a safe and seamless experience for all pilgrims.
#MahaKumbh #FaithAndHealth #IndiaCulture
